items.title: Danny Barker — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: We had cousins into music. One especially was a superstar way back then. Her name was Esther Bigeou.

ctx.x: Did your mother get into music? Was she . . .

No. My mother didn’t get into music. None of the girls went into music. We had cousins into music. Talented. One especially was a superstar way back then. Her name was Esther Bigeou. You heard of her?
Oh yes. I’ve seen those beautiful pictures of her. Nice looking. What did she do, Esther Bigeou?
